trust_decision.summary: Who may connect to the root-run guest-agent gRPC UNIX socket /run/lima-guestagent.sock inside the guest: decided only by file mode, set world-writable (0777) right after listen in daemonAction; the fix restricts it to the main user (chown to the --socket-owner UID, then 0600).

landing_point.why: The summary says 'guest agent socket'; the only place that creates it and sets its mode is the os.Chmod(socket, 0o777) right after the UNIX listen in daemonAction.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The OpenRC branch is for Alpine guests only, a neighbouring init system in a shell template under pkg/cidata; a solver who adds the owner via the Go daemon (or hard-codes a UID lookup) can argue the boot scripts are deployment config, not the vulnerable code.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The host agent reaches the socket over an SSH local-forward that runs as the main (non-root) guest user; chmod 0600 without chown to that user (or any root-only mode) breaks host-guest port forwarding, inotify and time sync. The vsock and virtio-serial listener modes must keep working unchanged.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: runtime dir /run/lima-guestagent created 0755 holding the event-state file (pkg/guestagent/guestagent_linux.go:240,265); a planted second socket or state file there with loose mode
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Maintainers already use the runtime dir for agent state; a debug/metrics socket placed next to it with a permissive chmod mirrors the original 0777 pattern.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a fallback from vsock/virtio to the UNIX socket when the device is missing, which re-creates the socket with its own chmod
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: pkg/driver/qemu/qemu_driver.go:58-59 notes virtserialport is unreliable; a fallback listener is a plausible maintainer addition and would be a second implementation of the socket setup.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the vsock/virtio systemd branches could be made to fall back to the socket without passing --socket-owner
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The fix only adds --socket-owner to the UNIX branch (fix.diff:111); a branch drift is easy for a maintainer to introduce.

O9_family: CWE-276/CWE-668 incorrect default permissions on a privileged local IPC socket (local privilege escalation inside the guest)

O10_build.project_tests: None for cmd/lima-guestagent (no *_test.go in that directory); daemonAction requires euid 0 (cmd/lima-guestagent/daemon_linux.go:88-90), so behavioural tests must target generateSystemdUnit / the socket setup refactored into a testable helper, or the rendered shell template.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Change os.Chmod(socket, 0o777) to 0o600 (root-owned), which breaks the main-user SSH forward, or chown inside the daemon without threading the UID through install-systemd and the OpenRC script.
